<quote by="Announced by Wren Ironclaw, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave"> To commission "The Iron Grove", a herb garden sinecure in Kallavesa with the title "Keeper of the Iron Grove". It will be appointed by the Wintermark senators with tenure.</quote>
==Overview==
* Creates a sinecure in Skymark, [[Kallavesa]] that produces eighteen herbs each season
* Announcement by the [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]
==Date==
* Spring 386YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 10 weirwood
* 30 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|The_Iron_Grove}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Keeper of the Iron Grove]] will be available to appoint by unanimous decision of the senators of Wintermark at the Summer Solstice 386YE.
